title: fragaria virginiana subsp. grayana
intro: Fragaria virginiana subsp. grayana, commonly known as the gray alpine strawberry, is a subspecies of the Fragaria virginiana plant, a type of wild strawberry native to the mountainous regions of North America. The gray alpine strawberry has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its high antioxidant content. The therapeutic actions of Fragaria virginiana subsp. grayana are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of the gray alpine strawberry include anthocyanins, ellagic acid, and salicylic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
